s: Born again to a living hope. Be holy, for God is holy.
You are a chosen race, a royal priesthood. Christ suffered for us, leaving an example.
Wives and husbands. Always be ready to give a reason for your hope.
Love covers a multitude of sins. Rejoice in sharing Christ's sufferings.
Elders, shepherd the flock. Cast all your cares on him. The devil prowls like a lion.
